name: Shaman
desc:
Shaman was an ancient deep-dwelling Ganymede Nomad, known for wielding Umbrite through forbidden rites.

Through these taboo rituals, Shaman was able to bend Umbrite to their will, shaping it into tools that appeared almost alive. Among these creations was the Shadebolt, forged through their mastery of these rites.

While some came to know the figure simply as "Shaman," others never learned a name at all.
